description: Issue #824 Part 1 / B1.1: neutralizes UpdateModelProperty's new FileAttachment-FK guard condition (compile-preserving operator: `dc.IsFileAttachmentForeignKeyProperty(entityType, prop.Name) && false`, never a deletion) so it can never fire, and checks it against MvcAuthHolesTests' HTTP-layer regression test. The posted value in that test is a REAL, persisted FileAttachment id (seeded under a DIFFERENT tenant) rather than a garbage GUID -- with the guard neutralized, the FK constraint is satisfied and the request succeeds (200), so the test's own status-code + message assertions on the negative half go red for the guard's absence specifically, not for an unrelated DB-level FK-constraint failure a garbage id could also produce. green_tests is a sibling MVC-004 test (Password blocklist) proving this mutation's blast radius is scoped to the new guard and does not collaterally affect the independent blockedFields check.
